labels.shortDescription: Compare refused: no Opportunity read access
labels.value: Comparing needs read access to Opportunities and to their Name, Amount and Close Date. Ask your administrator for it.

labels.shortDescription: Page refused: no Opportunity Mirror permission set
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror page needs the Opportunity Mirror permission set. Ask your administrator for it.

labels.shortDescription: Run skipped: automation paused
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror run did nothing, because automation is paused on the Automation page. The next run after it resumes catches up.

labels.shortDescription: Run skipped: automation switched off
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror run did nothing, because the Opportunity mirror is switched off on the Automation page. Switch it on for its runs to work again.

labels.shortDescription: Run: record type list names ones the org does not have
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror's record type list names record types this org does not have: {0}. They match no Opportunity, so no gift is made from them. Correct the list in the Opportunity mirror settings.

labels.shortDescription: Deleted gift: its Opportunity is left in place
labels.value: Its Opportunity is left in place. Delete it, or close it as lost, yourself if it should go.

labels.shortDescription: Deleted gift: its Opportunity will become a gift again
labels.value: Its Opportunity is left in place, and while it is won the next run makes a new gift from it. Close it as lost, or delete it, if the gift should stay gone.

labels.shortDescription: Deleted gift log: one gift
labels.value: The gift {0}, linked to an Opportunity, was deleted. {1}

labels.shortDescription: Deleted gift log: several gifts
labels.value: {0} gifts linked to Opportunities were deleted ({1}). {2}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: saver cannot write opportunities
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror skipped {0} gift(s): the person who saved them cannot create and edit Opportunities. The next run of the Opportunity mirror copies them, and any change to a gift that already has one.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: save too large to copy
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror did not copy the gifts in a very large save, because copying them in the same transaction would have gone past Salesforce limits. The gifts are saved without their Opportunities, and the next run of the Opportunity mirror copies them.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: one gift refused
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror could not copy the gift {0}: {1}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: many gifts refused, one reason
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror could not copy {0} gifts ({1}): {2}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: linked opportunity not found
labels.value: The Opportunity linked to the gift was deleted or is not visible to you. If it was deleted, clear the gift's Opportunity ID to have a new Opportunity made; if it still exists, give the person saving the gift access to it.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: org has no closed stage to use
labels.value: Salesforce has no active closed stage of the kind this gift needs (won for a gift in the totals, lost for a Cancelled one), so its Opportunity could not be written. Activate a Closed Won and a Closed Lost stage in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Gift save refused: Opportunity ID is not one
labels.value: Opportunity ID must be the record ID of an Opportunity (18 characters, starting 006), or empty.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: contact role refused
labels.value: The Opportunity was written, but its primary contact role could not be: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: new opportunity left unlinked
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror created the Opportunity {0} for this gift, could not store its Opportunity ID on the gift, and could not delete the Opportunity again: {1} Delete that Opportunity, or paste its ID onto the gift once the gift can be saved.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: a gift not saved yet
labels.value: new gift of {0} dated {1}

labels.shortDescription: Name given to a new mirrored opportunity
labels.value: {0} gift {1}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity name when the donor is not visible
labels.value: Donor

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: opportunity amount not above zero
labels.value: The Opportunity has no amount above zero, so no gift was made from it.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: opportunity names no donor
labels.value: The Opportunity has no primary contact and no account, so no gift was made from it. Give it a primary contact or an account, and the next run makes the gift.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: one opportunity refused
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror could not make a gift from the Opportunity {0}: {1}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: many opportunities refused, one reason
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror could not make gifts from {0} Opportunities ({1}): {2}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: what a gifts to opportunities run did
labels.value: Opportunity mirror run, Gifts to Opportunities: {0} Opportunities created, {1} updated, {2} already up to date, {3} could not be copied (see the Warnings), {4} left for the next run.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: what an opportunities to gifts run did
labels.value: Opportunity mirror run, Opportunities to Gifts: {0} gifts made, {2} Opportunities already had a gift, {3} could not become gifts (see the Warnings), {4} left for the next run.

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation: gift has no Opportunity
labels.value: No Opportunity

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation: linked Opportunity not found
labels.value: Opportunity deleted or not visible to you

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation: amounts disagree
labels.value: Amount differs

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation: dates disagree
labels.value: Date differs

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation: linked Opportunity not won
labels.value: Opportunity is not won

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation: won Opportunity with no gift
labels.value: Won Opportunity with no gift visible to you

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation refused: dates missing
labels.value: Choose a start date and an end date.

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation refused: dates reversed
labels.value: The start date must be on or before the end date.

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation refused: range too large
labels.value: This range holds more than 10,000 gifts or more than 10,000 won Opportunities, or more records than one comparison can read. Choose a shorter range.

labels.shortDescription: Page: org has no Opportunities
labels.value: This org has no Opportunities, so there is nothing to mirror. The Opportunity mirror needs a Salesforce edition with Opportunities, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, NPSP or Nonprofit Cloud.

labels.shortDescription: Page refusal: no direction chosen
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror is off. Choose a direction in Nonprofit Settings, Giving, Opportunity mirror direction.

labels.shortDescription: Page refusal: cannot manage settings
labels.value: Starting or scheduling the mirror needs the Manage Nonprofit Settings permission.

labels.shortDescription: Page refusal: cannot write Opportunities
labels.value: You cannot create and edit Opportunities, or you do not have the Opportunity Mirror permission set, so a run started by you would copy nothing.

labels.shortDescription: Page refusal: a run is in progress
labels.value: A run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

labels.shortDescription: Page refusal: copy again needs Gifts to Opportunities
labels.value: Copy these gifts again works only in Gifts to Opportunities: a gift is never changed from its Opportunity.

labels.shortDescription: Reconciliation refused: cannot read Opportunity ID
labels.value: Comparing needs the Opportunity Mirror permission set, which lets you read the Opportunity ID on a gift.

labels.shortDescription: Page: unexpected failure
labels.value: Something went wrong. The Error Log has the details.
